context: Two adults discuss a public-transit incident on the news
purpose: Teach: 車両/経由/地下鉄/有料/観戦/一貫/掲げ/違和感

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、さっきニュース見た？朝の地下鉄で車両故障があったらしいよ。
lines.en: Hey, did you see the news? Apparently there was a train car malfunction on the morning subway.
lines.style: Soft concerned tone, leaning slightly closer to him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、見た見た。先頭車両のドアが開かなくなったって。新宿経由で大学行く人、相当困っただろうな。
lines.en: Yeah, I saw. The front car's doors wouldn't open. People heading to uni via Shinjuku must have really struggled.
lines.style: Casual student voice, mildly sympathetic and relaxed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私も最初聞いた時、なんか違和感あったの。だって有料の特急まで全部止まったでしょ？
lines.en: When I first heard it, something felt off to me. Even the paid express trains all stopped, right?
lines.style: Puzzled tone, voice rising softly at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうそう。鉄道会社、安全第一って一貫した方針を掲げてるけど、今回の対応はちょっと遅すぎたよね。
lines.en: Right. The railway company holds up a consistent safety-first policy, but their response this time was a bit too slow.
lines.style: Thoughtful and measured, with a slightly critical undertone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 確かに。サッカー観戦に行く予定だった友達、試合に間に合わなかったって泣いてた。
lines.en: True. A friend who was going to a soccer match was crying that she couldn't make the game in time.
lines.style: Sympathetic and gentle, with a soft sigh between phrases.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うわ、それは気の毒。代替バスも全然来なかったらしいし。
lines.en: Ouch, that's rough. Apparently the replacement buses didn't come at all either.
lines.style: Wincing slightly, expressing casual but genuine concern.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、明日は私たちも電車使うけど、大丈夫かな…なんか不安。
lines.en: Hey, we're taking the train tomorrow too. I wonder if it'll be okay... I feel kind of uneasy.
lines.style: Worried tone, voice softening with quiet vulnerability.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大丈夫、俺がちゃんと運行情報チェックしとくから。心配しないで。
lines.en: It'll be fine, I'll check the service updates properly. Don't worry.
lines.style: Reassuring warmth, steady and gentle throughout the line.
